build_cuda_extension: build the mvpraymarch CUDA extension module by running python setup.py build_ext in the mvpraymarch directory
install_mvpraymarch: install the mvpraymarch package in development mode by running pip install -e . in the mvpraymarch directory
compile_bvh_kernel: compile the bvh.cu CUDA kernel as part of the mvpraymarchlib extension using nvcc with sm_70 architecture
compile_raymarch_kernel: compile the mvpraymarch_kernel.cu CUDA kernel with fast math and C++17 standard flags via the setup script
review_setup_config: review the setup.py configuration to verify nvcc compile flags and source file list for the mvpraymarch extension
